title: Nutmeg Infused Hunan Chicken Noodles
description: A peppery and molten solo dinner Chinese dish featuring vin santo and sous vide cooking, with a dash friendly approach.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then seal in a sous vide bag with nutmeg and cook at 130 degrees for 2 hours.
Cook the noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a small saucepan, combine hunan sauce, vin santo, soy sauce, and sesame oil, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the sauce by half, stirring occasionally, until it reaches a thick and molten consistency.
Remove the chicken from the sous vide bag and add to the saucepan with the sauce, tossing to coat.
Add the cooked noodles to the saucepan and toss everything together until the noodles are well coated with the sauce and chicken.
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and garnish with chopped scallions and red pepper flakes if using.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
